title: Nashville Studio with pool - Hip Melrose - 8th Ave
description:
Newly renovated studio! 
Our 'bnb used to be a 50's motel that was converted to condos. A little bit of nostalgia, only 2.5 miles to Broadway and 15 minutes from airport.
It has a hip 50's retro vibe, walkable to Hattie B's Hot Chicken and some of Nashville's best restaurants and bars.  
This upscale studio has a rain shower head, wood floors, contemporary furnishings , original art work from local artist,
60" flat screen TV, comfortable bedding, down comforter and other thoughtful amenities.

The space
You have an updated kitchen well appointed with dishes and cookware , you have a coffee station with a coffee pot/ keurig for one cup or a whole pot ! Lush bath products and towels in our newly renovated bathroom tub and shower combo . 
In season you have an amazing pool and patio area to relax and enjoy!

Other things to note
STR permit in accordance to Metro Nashville
